name: build-profiles help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:build-profiles. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Seed the plan
entries.text: A new profile's plan starts from the framework's seed and feature catalog instead of empty.

entries.title: Take off the list
entries.text: Removes the profile from the list. Its data stays on disk.

entries.title: Copy of
entries.text: Starts the new profile as a copy of another one.

entries.title: Use it right away
entries.text: Switches to the new profile as soon as it's made.
